mapper.sql: S.ID AS STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,S.MARKET ,S.SECURITY_TYPE ,(S.FEATURED_YN = 'Y') AS FEATURED ,S.LAST_TRADE_DATE AS TRADE_DATE ,S.LAST_CLOSE AS CLOSE_PRICE ,S.LAST_VOLUME AS VOLUME ,S.PREV_CLOSE ,S.LAST_CLOSE - S.PREV_CLOSE AS CHANGE_AMOUNT ,ROUND((S.LAST_CLOSE - S.PREV_CLOSE) / NULLIF(S.PREV_CLOSE, 0) * 100, 2) AS CHANGE_RATE ,S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING ,S.LAST_CLOSE * S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING AS MARKET_CAP
mapper.select: WITH TOP_CAP AS ( SELECT T.ID FROM T_STOCK T WHERE 1=1 AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND T.SECURITY_TYPE = 'STOCK' AND T.LAST_CLOSE IS NOT NULL AND T.SHARES_OUTSTANDING IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T.LAST_CLOSE * T.SHARES_OUTSTANDING DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) SELECT FROM T_STOCK S WHERE 1=1 AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND S.LAST_CLOSE IS NOT NULL AND ( S.FEATURED_YN = 'Y' OR S.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM TOP_CAP) ) ORDER BY MARKET_CAP DESC NULLS LAST ,S.ID
mapper.sql:
WHERE 1=1 AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND S.LAST_CLOSE IS NOT NULL
AND S.SECURITY_TYPE = 'ETF'
AND S.SECURITY_TYPE = 'STOCK' AND S.MARKET = #{marketFilter}
AND S.SECURITY_TYPE = 'STOCK'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM T_STOCK S
ORDER BY
CHANGE_RATE DESC NULLS LAST CHANGE_RATE ASC NULLS LAST S.LAST_CLOSE * S.LAST_VOLUME DESC NULLS LAST MARKET_CAP DESC NULLS LAST
,S.LAST_VOLUME DESC NULLS LAST ,S.ID LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM T_STOCK S WHERE 1=1 AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND ( S.NAME ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR S.SYMBOL LIKE #{query} || '%' ) ORDER BY (UPPER(S.NAME) = UPPER(#{query})) DESC ,(S.NAME ILIKE #{query} || '%') DESC ,(S.FEATURED_YN = 'Y') DESC ,MARKET_CAP DESC NULLS LAST ,S.NAME LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT R.STOCK_ID ,R.TRADE_DATE ,R.CLOSE_PRICE ,R.VOLUME FROM ( SELECT P.STOCK_ID ,P.TRADE_DATE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,P.VOLUME ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.STOCK_ID ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STOCK_ID IN #{id} AND P.TRADE_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} * 2 + 14) ) R WHERE 1=1 AND R.RN <= #{days} ORDER BY R.STOCK_ID ,R.TRADE_DATE

SELECT S.ID AS STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,S.MARKET ,D.TITLE AS DOC_TITLE ,D.CONTENT AS DOC_CONTENT FROM T_STOCK S LEFT JOIN T_STOCK_DOC D ON D.STOCK_ID = S.ID AND D.DEL_DAY IS NULL WHERE 1=1 AND S.SYMBOL = #{symbol} AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY D.ID LIMIT 1
SELECT P.TRADE_DATE ,P.OPEN_PRICE ,P.HIGH_PRICE ,P.LOW_PRICE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,P.VOLUME FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = P.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND S.SYMBOL = #{symbol} ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE
